materials.tray: Al 6061-T6, CNC, black anodized all over, inside faces included (emissivity ~0.85; insulation toward the board edge) except the masked contact faces (bare Al or conductive chromate conversion)
materials.lid: Al 6061-T6, CNC, black anodized (emissivity ~0.85) except the masked contact faces (bare Al or conductive chromate conversion)
materials.plate: Al 5052 or 6061, 0.8 mm, bare (no anodize, no paint); no thermal paste on any contact face (posts, shoulders, rims)
materials.gapfill: dispensed gap filler, low modulus, about 3 W/mK
materials.boss_pad: gap pad 5.6 x 5.6 x 0.5 mm, soft (Shore 00 below 40), about 3 W/mK, between the U7 package and the tray boss
materials.washer: closed-cell silicone or urethane (PORON type) foam washer, OD 3.6 x ID 2.2 x 1.5 mm free, one on each screw between the PCB top and the lid post end; not conductive
materials.pigtail: U.FL (I-PEX MHF1) plug to SMA bulkhead jack, 1.13 mm cable, 100 mm; 1/4-36 UNS thread, 8 mm rear hex, nut and lock washer outside; external 2.4 GHz antenna, SMA plug

masked.post_shoulder: lid post shoulders (5.5 mm) that clamp the plate
masked.lid_rim: lid rim face that sits on the plate
masked.post_bore: lid M2 tapped bores (thread contact to the screw)
masked.tray_post_end: tray post necked end faces that bear on the PCB bottom GND rings
masked.tray_rim: tray rim face under the plate

acceptance: lid to board GND (J5 USB-C shell) < 1 ohm, measured after assembly with a 4-wire or low-range ohmmeter
plate to board GND < 1 ohm, measured the same way
tray to board GND < 1 ohm, measured the same way
lid_hold: three M2 screws only. The board has no hole in the fourth corner (design (18, 18)), so nothing can pass it to a screw; that corner holds C72/C73 underneath and the J6 plug and wires on top. The lid is a rigid aluminium cup and its fourth corner rests on the plate and the tray rim, so it cannot be pushed in; three clamped corners fix its plane. A lip into the tray is not possible because the plate lies across the split.
screws: 3 x M2 x 16 from the bottom, head seat z 1.8, tapped M2 in the lid posts

compliant.note: the only rigid seat is lid rim / plate / tray rim; the lid posts do not touch the PCB

panel: no V-cut on any edge; routed outline with mouse-bite tabs set inside the outline or filed flush after break-out: nothing may stand proud of the 40.00 mm outline
assembly: SMA jack through the -x wall hole from inside, lock washer and nut outside, before the PCB goes in
U.FL plug onto J8 (board underside), cable laid on the floor clear of the U7 boss
PCB onto the three tray posts
one foam washer over each screw hole on the PCB top
gap filler on the module shield, plate, lid; three M2 x 16 from below
